narrative.overview: ZINC mobile extends the incumbent ocean-blue visual world into an Expo application for iOS, Android and web. Rich blue frames pale, rounded panels; clear type and factual counts make a dated week easy to follow. This document captures implemented source rather than a new visual direction. The root [DESIGN.md](../DESIGN.md) continues to describe the Streamlit fallback.
keyCharacteristics: Ocean-blue framing with pale content surfaces.
Rounded controls and readable, explicit labels.
Completion and evidence presented with their meaning in words.
Persistent Stop access and explicit acceptance of proposed changes.

rules.name: The Meaning in Words Rule
rules.body: Status and evidence stay readable as text; color alone never supplies their meaning.

dos: Do extend the incumbent ocean-blue canvas and pale rounded panels.
Do keep weekday/count text adjacent to the curve and completion denominators visible.
Do keep Stop accessible in the root header, active-session bar and shared sheets.
Do use plain-text coach replies and explicit proposal acceptance.
donts: Don't describe a completion ring as a health score.
Don't flatten Strong, Moderate and Emerging evidence into one badge level.
Don't infer that a timer completes or records an activity automatically.
